caption:
i love me a content guru who says the only way to go viral is by using their formats and systems that they created that only works for them 😻 (sarcasm)

there is no one size fits all solution

but when you understand the frequency and philosophy

you can make systems that apply to YOU

especially if you wanna do it in a way that feels aligned and authentic to your truth?

you won’t get that with a 30 day AI content plan 🤣

you get it with self reflection, understanding, a little trial and error, and being seen by people who understand you enough to tell you what they see in you

If you want that community and help from me,

comment ‘inevitable’ and I’ll reach out

you deserve to honor your authenticity

not sold into another box that keeps you from shining
author: richard sabiaga
transcript: So this post two days ago got me 60,000 followers. Here's what I hate about content guru's advice as someone who actually has five million across platforms. Content creation can be as simple as you allow it to be. Guess what? I scripted, filmed, edited, and posted that video in 20 minutes. All you need for virality is this. Understand your audience, which is a reflection of you so well, that you say the things that bring out emotion because when people feel things, be it connection, anger, excitement, it sparks engagement. And then, when you say the things that people aren't saying, they share it organically. If you understand the principles of content and why it works, you don't need to follow a fucking format and system that waters down your authenticity. It allows you to be creative and original because ultimately, it's about making something that you're proud of. Do systems and formats work? Yes, but where do you think they come from? You can copy the actions and routines and systems, but you cannot copy the frequency, the source of all of it. When you understand frequency, you become inevitable. If you want help with content coaching and want your message to reach more people, comment inevitable, I'll reach out, or don't comment it, the information's all here.
title: Forget Content Formats — Understand Frequency
one_liner: Viral content comes from understanding your audience's emotions, not copying someone else's format or system.
key_points: Emotion drives virality — content that sparks connection, anger, or excitement gets shared organically
Systems and formats work, but they stem from a deeper 'frequency' you can't copy from someone else
Authentic content creation requires self-reflection and trial-and-error, not a 30-day AI plan
Know your audience so well you say the things others aren't saying — that's what drives organic sharing
